operation.name: GetNonGBVAttachments
operation.query:
SELECT [NonGBVAttachmentID] ,[NonGBVDetailID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID]
FROM [NonGBVAttachment] WHERE [Deleted] = 0 AND [NonGBVDetailID] = @NonGBVDetailID order by [NonGBVAttachmentID] ASC
